hooks.name: load-agents-and-workflow-context
hooks.description: Loads and injects mandates and docs/development/AgenticFramework.md as startup context for the session

hooks.name: review-phase-before-subagent
hooks.description: Verifies Gate 1, runs automated tests, and injects active plan checklist before review_agent execution

hooks.name: plan-phase-before-ask-user
hooks.description: Enforces plan format validation before asking for plan approval

hooks.name: commit-phase-before-ask-user
hooks.description: Enforces sequential pipeline progression before asking for developer commit approval

hooks.name: plan-phase-before-exit-plan-mode
hooks.description: Enforces that a valid plan-approval.json signature exists before exiting plan mode

hooks.name: block-restricted-commands
hooks.description: Prevents running direct git commit, push, and rancher remote operations

hooks.name: plan-phase-before-write
hooks.description: Blocks file writes if Plan Mode is required but not entered

hooks.name: commit-phase-before-write
hooks.description: Blocks file writes when changes are pending commit approval

hooks.name: plan-phase-before-replace
hooks.description: Blocks text replacements if Plan Mode is required but not entered

hooks.name: commit-phase-before-replace
hooks.description: Blocks text replacements when changes are pending commit approval

hooks.name: plan-phase-after-enter-plan-mode
hooks.description: Prepares the session workspace when Plan Mode is successfully entered

hooks.name: plan-phase-after-exit-plan-mode
hooks.description: Cleans up workspace planning flags on successful Plan Mode exit

hooks.name: plan-phase-after-ask-user
hooks.description: Generates cryptographic planning signatures upon user approval

hooks.name: commit-phase-after-ask-user
hooks.description: Generates cryptographic commit signatures upon user approval

hooks.name: review-phase-after-subagent
hooks.description: Saves review reports and secures review signatures upon verified success
